original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical CUDA.jl genuinely computes native box-span means/crop/pad, but omits the native shared staging tiles and block barrier, reading input directly for each output. Its CPU oracle uses Float64 ratio while device/native use Float32; edge kernel redundantly rewrites interior values. Study preserves original bytes, restores shared staging and original16x16mapping, aligns Float32 host coordinate arithmetic, and uses an algebraically equivalent outside-only clamp for native edge copies. These are mapping/oracle-precision changes, not an established historical wrong operator.
original_reference_provenance.native_fallback_scope: get_sm_size repeats blocks[0] in its fallback loop; smaller listed blocks are never selected. Measured capacities all<48KiB and use original16x16. Huge-shrink fallback remains unmeasured source-host limitation, not framework unsupported.
